title: HELLSING
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The Hellsing Organization, a secret English Protestant order led by Sir Integra Hellsing, hunts vampires and ghouls using Alucard, an ancient vampire bound to the family's service. Police officer Seras Victoria becomes a vampire to survive and joins them. The war climaxes in London as Hellsing, the Vatican's Iscariot section and the Nazi remnant Millennium, with its vampire battalion, collide.
life_message: It holds up the will to stay human and to choose one's fate, set against monsters who have given that up.

content.note: Critics call it 'fetishistic' and 'demented ultraviolence'; dismemberment, massacres of London (Wikipedia; AniList Gore 87%, Cannibalism, Terrorism).
Vampire horror, body horror and city-wide slaughter (Wikipedia; genre Horror; AniList Body Horror).
Nudity flagged by MangaUpdates; fan-service framing of Seras (to verify).
Smoking and drug signal in database tags (AniList Drugs signal; to verify).
Integra witnessed her father's murder; despairing villains (Wikipedia; to verify).
Gun violence styled as cool (AniList Guns 81%; to verify).
